### {{< var link.stage1rr >}}

Peer-reviewed manuscript of study justification and planned procedure/analysis plan (given *In Principle Acceptance* by *Nature Human Behaviour* in March 2024)
:::

::: {.callout-note title="resource"}
### {{< var link.projectmanual >}}

This document
:::

::: {.callout-note title="resource"}
### {{< var link.collaboration >}}

Outlines roles/responsibilities, authorship info, and other info all contributors agree to abide by *(can also be found in @sec-collaboration)*
:::

::: {.callout-note title="resource"}
### MB5 Forms {.unnumbered}

-   {{< var link.issue >}}: To report issues (e.g., with data collection, deviations from protocol, etc.) or to request support
-   {{< var link.greenlight >}}: To upload materials required to get a "green light" for data collection (e.g., ethics approval, questionnaire, pilot data)
-   {{< var link.pretest >}}: To provide information about your lab's testing setup and to request final approval to begin data collection
-   {{< var link.upload >}}: To upload experimental data
:::
